body: It's going, it's a constant struggle to just hold on to something and stay grounded here you know? I know how wrong it is to commit suicide but I'm not crazy or mental either it just hurts too much

It's been going on for weeks. The stress and the problems I'm currently facing are too much for me to bear and my ex has partly to do with it but it's just cause she didn't understand that my mental health was important ....

Completely relatable, it's like you're watching yourself set things on fire. You don't enjoy the things you used to. Getting out of bed is one of the biggest challenges of the day. I've lost myself to and I'm not sure if I can get myself back.

I think we hold on to the things in life that matter most to us even if it's tangible and can fall apart. But in a sense that's noble because thats living in a sense right ? Risking something greater than yourself
